The '''[[ESL Grand Slam]]''' is a prize of $1,000,000 to the first team that wins four [[S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier events]] organized by [[ESL]] during a window of 10 consecutive events including an IEM Kraków, IEM Cologne, or ESL-operated '''[[Majors|CS Major Championship]]'''. This prize is given directly to the players.

There is also a spoils bonus for any team that denies another team their final victory towards the ESL Grand Slam by defeating them in a grand final. The spoiling team is awarded $100,000.

All qualifying events can be seen in the table at the bottom of the page.
